race.comment: FOREVER JEUNE (7) was in the money two starts back at Ballarat Synthetic then wound up from the back last time when eighth, beaten 4.5 lengths, at Ballarat Synthetic over 1500m. First try at the trip and should be tough to stop. MICKIO (2) travelled in a rearwards position then picked up fairly well in the straight and finished 3.5 lengths away in fourth last time out over 1600m at Echuca three weeks ago. Won only try here and despite the wide draw is worth following up. DURHAM (3) scored two runs back then was well in commission last time and wound up late over 2000m at Murray Bridge. Finds a nice race and can bounce back. MANGIONE (4) was unplaced two runs back then again missed the frame last start over 2050m at Murtoa, beaten 2.5 lengths into fifth. Hard to beat on his best form. AHAB (1) is back to the turf but in great form and among the main chances.
